decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the song "Shy Boy," and the provided sources directly identify three distinct artists for three distinct versions of the song. D1S1 identifies Bananarama as the artist of the 1983 English version. D2S1 identifies Secret as the artist of the 2011 South Korean version. D4S1 identifies Katie Melua as the artist of the 2005 UK version. Each claim is supported by its own source and refers to a distinct version of the song. There is no contradiction within the same referent, so all three are valid and distinct answers.
